review_candidates.description: Who We Are EnglishScore is the British Council's mobile English test. Our AI-powered app tests and certifies English levels in over 170 countries, and more than 2.5 million new users take it every year. Universities, employers and government departments use it to test and certify their students, staff and citizens. The Role This is an international role. You'll market EnglishScore to learners and partners across Asia, Latin America and beyond, not to Turkey specifically. All our marketing is in English, and so is the team. You don't need any other language. You'll work directly with our Head of Marketing, who sets the strategy. You make it happen. Half the job is creative: telling stories that make people act. You work with the account manager to find out why, then plan and run the campaign that fixes it. Learners worry their English isn't good enough to test. Your campaigns, files and trackers are so organised that anyone can find anything. Before anything goes out, you catch what's off: spacing, hierarchy, a weak headline. This applies whether it was made by you, an AI tool or an agency. Keeping our socials active weekly (Instagram and LinkedIn) as a positive trust signal for prospects. You're Right For This If Your English is excellent (EnglishScore of 480+) You can tell a story that makes someone act, then show us the numbers afterwards You're structured by nature: trackers, naming, deadlines, follow-through You take a rough idea and get it live without being chased You have an eye for design and can make a decent mock-up (Canva, Figma or AI tools) You have 2–4 years of hands-on marketing and can show what your work achieved. The Details Location: Remote. You must already have the right to work in Turkey Reports to: Head of Marketing. How To Apply Send us three things: Your CV Two or three sentences answering this: why might someone put off taking an English test, and what would you do about it? Your EnglishScore result. Take the test in the EnglishScore app. We won't consider applications that are missing any of these. We're an equal opportunity employer and follow the British Council's global equality policy. We welcome applicants of every background.
